answers.reason: Professors are not explicitly mentioned as members of the senate, which decides on university-wide matters.
Funding decisions are part of the university-wide plan where groups of higher rank or administration are involved.
Professors hold professorships and are directly concerned with selecting candidates for vacant professorships.
Faculty councils decide on the affairs of one faculty, which includes the professors belonging to that faculty.
Examination matters are handled by administration or specific boards, not automatically by professors unless specified.
